$Comment: Cogling: the Heartworks' swarmer, a brass beetle with a wind-up key (DESIGN.md 6.1 to 6.3). 50 HP, speed 9, brave only in a flock of its own kind (round 2: above the Deepworks Scrapper, 45 HP, swings 12 and 16). Nip 13 every 1 to 1.8 s; Pounce 20 from 3 to 5 blocks every 8 s, then tipped over for 0.5 s; every 20 s of chasing it rewinds its key for 1.5 s. Its brain is Machinaria_Heartworks_Cogling_Template.
